_doc: PDR-3 ConvergenceValidator eval input (plan §2.5). Per Camillo case: the multi-SOURCE CatalystItem set the cross-source require_ensemble validates. Validated (>=2 independent families) cases carry a reddit + google_trends + news item each; the negative cases carry a single-source set so they are dropped (not scored) when HERMES_QUANT_CONVERGENCE=1. Synthetic per-family framings of each case headline (mirroring how social.py frames reddit/trends headlines), so the eval is offline + deterministic. The realized forward returns the precision gate scores against live in camillo_labels.json; here we only encode the source SET that decides validation. B08 will replace these with live reddit/trends/web-traffic producers; the mechanism + taxonomy + this unit eval build and pass NOW.
